exposure: Maternal age, BMI, parity, AFT, baseline Bishop score
cohort: 400 women with term singleton pregnancies and a Bishop score < 6
finding: The marginal benefit of administering more than 7 misoprostol tablets (over 14 hours) during cervical ripening is very low.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery likelihood significantly increased with maternal age, BMI, nulliparity, AFT, and baseline Bishop Score.
